findings.evidence: `grep -n cohomF2Cup` in the repo hits only lines 69, 146, 151, 293 of this file — no `_def`/`_apply` lemma. `cup` is defined at Cup/Cohomology.lean:167 and every usable identity (e.g. TrivialF2.lean:89 `trivialF2Map_cup`, :192 `trivialF2TopPairing_cup_one_one_explicitH1`) is stated about `cup`, not `cohomF2Cup`.
findings.fix: Either drop `cohomF2Cup` and phrase `gMul_eq_cup`/`of_mul_of` directly as `(trivialF2TopPairing G).cup m n x y`, or add `@[simp] theorem cohomF2Cup_apply (m n) (x y) : cohomF2Cup G m n x y = (trivialF2TopPairing G).cup m n x y := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `cohomF2Cup` is a plain `def` wrapping `(trivialF2TopPairing G).cup m n` with no characterizing lemma, and its body is not `@[expose]`d. Since `gMul_eq_cup` (l.150) and `of_mul_of` (l.291) state the ring multiplication only in terms of `cohomF2Cup`, no consumer can connect a product in `cohomologyF2 G` to the cup product — `cup_assoc`, `cup_gradedComm`, `cup_res`, `cup_projection`, `trivialF2Map_cup`, `trivialF2TopPairing_cup_one_one_explicitH1` all become unreachable, as does bilinearity, which `cohomF2Cup`'s bare function type also discards.

findings.evidence: `cohomF2One` occurs only at lines 73, 142, 156, 198–203, 260–287, 302; no `_eq`/`_def`. `ContinuousCohomology.degreeZeroClass` and its API are public at ContCohomology/DegreeZero.lean:221, 230, 237.
findings.fix: Add `theorem cohomF2One_eq : cohomF2One G = ContinuousCohomology.degreeZeroClass (trivialF2 G) ((trivialF2Equiv G).symm 1) (fun g ↦ trivialF2_ρ_apply_apply G g _) := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `cohomF2One` likewise has no characterizing lemma; `gOne_eq_one` (l.156) is circular and `algebraMap_apply` (l.300) only restates it. Downstream the degree-zero unit cannot be identified with the class of `1`, so nothing about `H⁰` (`zeroIso`, `degreeZeroClass_eq_π`, nontriviality, the `H^•(C₂,𝔽₂) = 𝔽₂[x]` worked example the roadmap lists) can be proved about it.

findings.evidence: Cup/TrivialF2.lean:74 `theorem trivialF2TopPairing_bil_comm` (public); Cup/Unit.lean:114 `(hu : ∀ x : X.V, P.bil u x = x)` is the hypothesis of `cup_one_left` (:146) and :99 of `cup_one_right`.
findings.fix: Move all three to Cup/TrivialF2.lean as public lemmas beside `trivialF2TopPairing_bil_comm` (e.g. `trivialF2TopPairing_bil_one_left`, `..._one_right`, `trivialF2TopPairing_bil_assoc`) and apply them here.
findings.issue: `cup_one_coeff_left` (l.110), `cup_one_coeff_right` (l.117) and `cup_coeff_assoc` (l.124) are the unit and associativity laws of the public `trivialF2TopPairing`, with proofs independent of this file's subject. They are exactly the hypotheses `cup_one_left`/`cup_one_right`/`cup_assoc` demand, so every other consumer of the 𝔽₂ cup must re-prove them, while the sibling law `trivialF2TopPairing_bil_comm` is already public in the pairing's home file.

findings.evidence: DegreeCast.lean:68–87 has public `degreeCast`, `degreeCast_rfl`, `degreeCast_symm` and no HEq companion; `grep -rn "degreeCast.*≍"` hits only this PR. No `ZMod n` zero-or-one lemma exists in Mathlib/Data/ZMod or in TauCeti (`grep -rn eq_zero_or_one`).
findings.fix: State `degreeCast_heq` for a general `X` and put it public in ContCohomology/DegreeCast.lean beside `degreeCast_rfl`; make `zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one` a public `ZMod` lemma in its canonical home (it is `by decide`); state `cast_zero` for a general family or inline it.
findings.issue: General infrastructure kept `private`: `degreeCast_heq` (l.130) holds for any `X : TopRep R G` and is proved by `subst; simp` with no input from this file, and `zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one` (l.249) mentions only `ZMod 2`. `cast_zero` (l.135) is the same pattern for an arbitrary family of `Zero`s.

summary: The packaged product and unit are opaque: neither `cohomF2Cup` nor `cohomF2One` has a lemma relating it to `TopPairing.cup` / `degreeZeroClass`, so the whole graded surface (`gMul_eq_cup`, `of_mul_of`) is disconnected from every existing cup theorem. Several reusable results about the public `trivialF2TopPairing`, and two general-infrastructure lemmas, are hidden as `private` here instead of living public in their canonical files.
